instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Make a tracked link with UTM fields for a post, ad, email or bio, so visits and sales can be traced to it", and give it destination (The web page the link opens); project (Your name for what is being promoted, letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores); source (Where the link is posted, like instagram or newsletter); campaign.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:make-tracked-link and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Adds the project, source and campaign (and optionally the medium and a content tag for one post) to a web address as UTM fields, replacing any already there.
